svg.title: What happens when a lot arrives at a tool
svg.desc: A carrier lands on an etch tool; the tool reports its ID through equipment automation to the MES, which runs seven interlock checks, then downloads the recipe and records track-in; the tool processes the lot, track-out is recorded and the history gains a row, and the carrier moves on. Illustrative values.
svg.text: A lot arrives at a tool: checks first, then track-in
Carrier lands on the load port; the tool reads its ID.
Tool reports the ID; the MES is asked: may this lot track in here?
The MES runs every interlock check. One failure blocks the lot.
All passed: track-in recorded, correct recipe version downloaded.
Processing runs; sensor data streams to FDC in real time.
Track-out recorded; tool, chamber, recipe and times join the history.
MES assigns the next step; material handling carries the lot away.
